method:
Differential host qualification for animation scheduling and torch caching.

The actual baseline/candidate animation C functions run against all three
linked ROM descriptor/payload sets and synthetic valid byte-sized descriptors.
Recorded DMA destinations, ordered bytes, palette writes and volatile clock
read counts must match. Explicit clock-read fixtures model wrap, reset and
interrupt changes between the due test and frame selection. These host tests
do not replace real mGBA progression, framebuffer or cycle measurements.

animation_stack.scope: Compiler-reported static tiles_animate stack allocation without profiling instrumentation; excludes callers, callees and interrupt stack.

torches.method:
Differential test of the unlit-torch cache through actual room write APIs.

The original/candidate room mutation and torch-count C functions are compiled
against native ROM metadata. Video/forest/interactive rendering is stubbed,
while room geometry, collision rebuilding and barrier-substrate selection use
the extracted C. Preview-details uses its actual save/restore function with a
disclosed deterministic generator stub that calls the real room write APIs.
No generator, game, art or ARM build is changed by this test.
